name: claude-code-log
description: Local dashboard for browsing Claude Code history across all your repos.
author: Justin Higgins

scripts.demo: npm run fixtures && D="$(pwd -P)" && CLAUDE_CODE_LOG_ROOTS="$D/fixtures" VITE_LOG_DIR="$D/fixtures/projects" VITE_REPO_ROOT="$D/fixtures/repos" vite
scripts.demo:shots: CCL_FIXTURES_DIR=/tmp/demo-operator CCL_FIXTURES_REPOS=/tmp/demo-operator/code npm run fixtures && CLAUDE_CODE_LOG_ROOTS=/tmp/demo-operator VITE_LOG_DIR=/tmp/demo-operator/projects VITE_REPO_ROOT=/tmp/demo-operator/code vite
